{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Count how many converted customers there are
n_converted = len(converted_customers)

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (non-supplied)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Count how many valid converted customers remain
n_valid = len(valid_converted_customers)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all relevant numbers
print(f'Number of converted customers: {n_converted}')
print(f'Number excluded (age == -1): {n_converted - n_valid}')
print(f'Number of valid converted customers (age != -1): {n_valid}')
print(f'Mean age of valid converted customers: {mean_age}')"}
